# chunked bodies
check('basic chunked', shape(channel_blob(
    b'POST / HTTP/1.1
Host: h
Transfer-Encoding: chunked

5
hello
0

')),
    [('ok', 'chunked', 5, 0, 71, 1, UN)])
check('chunked uppercase hex', shape(channel_blob(
    b'POST / HTTP/1.1
Transfer-Encoding: chunked

A
0123456789
0000000

'))[0][2], 10)
check('chunked extension', shape(channel_blob(
    b'POST / HTTP/1.1
Transfer-Encoding: chunked

3;a=b;c
ddd
0;x

'))[0][2], 3)
check('chunked empty extension', shape(channel_blob(
    b'POST / HTTP/1.1
Transfer-Encoding: chunked

3;
ddd
0

'))[0][2], 3)
check('chunked zero chunk only', shape(channel_blob(
    b'POST / HTTP/1.1
Transfer-Encoding: chunked

0

'))[0][2], 0)
check('chunked body fingerprint',
      channel_blob(b'POST / HTTP/1.1
Transfer-Encoding: chunked

'
                   b'2ab
3cde
0

')['requests'][0]['body'],
      {'n': 5, 'h': '%016x' % hash_bytes(b'abcde')})
check('chunked trailers',
      channel_blob(b'POST / HTTP/1.1
Transfer-Encoding: chunked

'
                   b'1a
0
X: y
Z: w

')['requests'][0]['trailers'],
      {'n': 44, 'h': '%016x' % hash_bytes(
          (2).to_bytes(8, 'big') + (1).to_bytes(8, 'big') + b'X' + (1).to_bytes(8, 'big') + b'y'
          + (1).to_bytes(8, 'big') + b'Z' + (1).to_bytes(8, 'big') + b'w')})

', 'incomplete'),

X: y
', 'incomplete'),
